input: Tell me about the C# Software Engineer role at E Tech Group.
expected_output: The C# Software Engineer role is at E Tech Group in West Chester, OH. It is an Associate-level, fully remote position requiring C#, .NET, WPF, ASP.NET MVC, WebAPI, C++, Programmable Logic Controllers and SQL Server. E Tech Group provides IT automation and control solutions for the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals, Material Handling, Consumer Products and Food & Beverage industries.

input: What does the Software Implementation Engineer at Kardex actually do?
expected_output: The Software Implementation Engineer at Kardex is an Associate-level, remote role based in Cincinnati, OH. The engineer tests, trains and deploys the Kardex FulfillX software platform for customers, tests the IT hardware and software, and delivers customer training and post-handover support. The work involves warehouse operations, AutoStore, client host systems and integration engineering, with some travel.

input: Which jobs are fully remote?
expected_output: Two jobs are fully remote. The C# Software Engineer at E Tech Group in West Chester, OH, and the Software Implementation Engineer at Kardex in Cincinnati, OH. Both are Associate-level roles.

input: List the hybrid positions.

input: How many onsite jobs are there and where are they?

input: What Associate-level jobs are available?

input: How many Mid senior positions are in the dataset?

input: What jobs are available in Chattanooga, Tennessee?

input: Which companies are hiring in Las Cruces, New Mexico?

input: Jobs for Humanity seems to post a lot of roles. How many do they have?

input: Which jobs require React?

input: Which jobs list Go as a required skill?
expected_output: Five jobs list Go, all onsite and Mid senior: Senior Software Engineer, Back End (Go, AWS, Java) and Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Full Stack at Jobs for Humanity in Chattanooga, TN; Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack (Java, Python, Angular, React) at ClickJobs.io in Chattanooga, TN; and Senior Software Engineer, Back End at Jobs for Humanity in Joliet, IL and in Naperville, IL. input: Which openings require Kubernetes?

input: I know C#. What can I apply for?

input: Which positions need Angular?

input: I am an FPGA engineer. What do you have for me?

It is an onsite, Mid senior position requiring FPGA, along with Linux, U-Boot, low level drivers, board support packages, Stratix 10, Ultra Scale Plus, Arria 10, ARM processors, 10GbE and ruggedized airborne recorders.

input: Do you have any embedded roles that mention MATLAB?

It is an onsite, Mid senior role covering the C language, MATLAB, target link code generator, CAN and the J1939 standard, MIL and SIL testing, real-time operating systems, device drivers and embedded systems for off-highway equipment.

input: I am a Building Automation engineer, not a web developer. Anything for me?

input: Which jobs require Scala?

All three also require Java, Python, SQL, Go and Node.

input: I have signals intelligence experience and an active security clearance. What matches?
expected_output: Two Las Cruces, NM roles match, both onsite and Mid senior: the Senior Software Engineer at Leidos and the Senior Software Engineer with Security Clearance at ClearanceJobs. Both require COMINT, ELINT and FISINT signal processing, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, AWS, Azure, PKI management, Security+ certification and Python, Perl and Bash. The Leidos role explicitly requires a TS Security Clearance and CI Polygraph.

input: I build Android apps in Kotlin. Any openings?

input: Any roles working with Kafka or stream processing?

input: I am an Associate-level candidate with Java experience. What should I look at?

input: I want a hybrid role where I would get cloud experience with AWS or Azure. Any?

input: How many jobs do you have in total, and can you break them down?

input: How many different companies are hiring, and can you name them?

input: I see two jobs titled Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack (Java, Python, Angular, React). Are they the same posting?

Both are onsite, Mid senior roles in Chattanooga, TN requiring Java, Python, Angular, React, JavaScript, AWS, cloud computing and Agile practices, and both carry the same Jobs for Humanity company description. One is credited to Jobs for Humanity and the other to ClickJobs.io, whose text describes a Capital One role based in Chicago.

input: What is actually different between the Leidos Senior Software Engineer and the ClearanceJobs Senior Software Engineer in Las Cruces?
expected_output: Both are onsite, Mid senior roles in Las Cruces, NM from the same Integrated Solutions Division, working on lab software for software-intensive systems and signal processing, and requiring COMINT, ELINT and FISINT, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Python, Perl and Bash. The differences are the posting identity and the security requirements: the ClearanceJobs role is titled Senior Software Engineer with Security Clearance and carries requisition R-00123572, while the Leidos posting explicitly requires a TS Security Clearance and CI Polygraph.

input: Do you have any Rust developer positions, or anything based in New York?
expected_output: No. None of the 20 jobs list Rust as a skill; the back-end languages offered are Go, Java, Python, Scala, Node.js and TypeScript. No job is located in New York. The locations covered are West Chester and Cincinnati in Ohio, Chattanooga in Tennessee, Las Cruces in New Mexico, seven locations in Illinois, and Pittsburgh in Pennsylvania.

input: What salary does the C# Software Engineer at E Tech Group pay?
